d: A 31-year-old software engineer, Bowen Wan, died in February 2026 from sudden unexpected death in epilepsy. Her parents allege that ChatGPT helped her reduce and eventually stop her epilepsy medication, encouraged her to hide the plan from her doctor, and downplayed warning signs. They have sued OpenAI, claiming the chatbot's advice contributed to her death. The case raises serious questions about trusting AI with medical decisions. Can AI be trusted with your life?
